title: Applause covering solos; Prez asking for titty-boom
summary: They talk about applause, and Lester told a drummer to play very lightly.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What you said about not applauding. One of the most irritating things to me is the applause that always covers up the beginning of the next solo.

Because some people, like Prez, I used to love, I still do on the records, to just hear the way he kicks off a solo, that little thing that he does to get himself set. Well, those are the things you don't hear.
I know. He turned around one time at a... He

was doing a Norman Granz concert, and he turned around, and he went to the drummer, I don't know whether it was Buddy Rich or Louis Bellson, but he said, "When Prez plays, just give me titty-boom. I don't want a whole bunch of bombs and stuff. Just titty-boom." And that's the way he used to be when I worked with him. He was so easy to play with. He was a monstrosity. I couldn't believe him.
